Name: Darbar Hazrat Shah Gohar Peer
site_type_note: Shrine (*darbār*) with adjoining mosque, in a residential area beside a graveyard

Name: Darbar Mian Qurban Ali Shah
site_type_note: Tomb-shrine with adjoining mosque in the same courtyard, and a closed basement chamber beneath the tomb

Name: Darbar Abul Muali Qadri
status_note: Active; in use daily, construction ongoing
site_type_note: Shrine complex (tomb, mosque, graveyard; originated as a mosque and seminary)

Name: Darbar Malik Ahmad Ayaz
status_note: Active; physically constrained. Reported as occupying a small area reduced by losses in the Sikh era and by market encroachment, with access impeded by crowding in the surrounding bazaar and declining visitor enthusiasm.
site_type_note: Tomb shrine (*mazār*/*darbār*) with an associated mosque in its vicinity

Name: Shaktipeeth Shri Hinglaj Mata Mandir
year_built_note: Natural cave shrine of unrecorded antiquity; Hinglaj Sheva Mandali temple committee established 1986
Events: Hinglaj Yatra (April, four days) — the largest Hindu pilgrimage in Pakistan; ritual halts at Chandragup and the Hingol river en route
